verifications.claim: The Android Data Collection lawsuit alleges that Android devices sent data to Google over cellular networks even when idle.

verifications.reasoning: Precisely describes allegations of idle data transfer over cellular.

verifications.claim: The Android Data Collection lawsuit resulted in a $135 million settlement.

verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm $135M for Android data collection case (Taylor v. Google).
